decisions: Rename working product from MindGuard to StressCast because MindGuard has multiple 2026 collisions in mental health and AI safety.
Primary wedge is an explainable 30-day burnout/load forecast, not a generic wellness chatbot.
Core calculation must be deterministic/statistical; an LLM may only draft explanations from structured outputs.
Use at most 8 self-report inputs and no lab/device inputs in MVP.
No voice, camera, biometrics or emotion recognition in v1.
Phase 1 validates demand with email-for-report and owner copy; Phase 2 adds payment.
If Agent 2 cannot validate longitudinal prediction, output is labeled projection/scenario rather than probability.
Stage 2 normalizes the stage-1 PIVOT-ready status to DATA_READY after implementing the approved fallback.
Use the complete 7-item CBI Work-related subscale for the numeric core; country only localizes price/language and never changes the score.
Do not expose a calibrated 30-day probability: no open, commercially usable longitudinal dataset at the required 30-day horizon was found.
Replace forecast probability with a deterministic conditional scenario envelope: no-change, up to two eligible items improve one response category, or up to two worsen one category.
Treat scenario_items_changed=2 as a preliminary product sensitivity assumption, not a causal or statistical estimate.
Remove weekly hours and sleep from v1 scoring because no validated coefficient was found to convert them into 30-day CBI points.
A large-language model may narrate structured outputs but may not calculate the score, scenarios, cutoff, benchmark delta or expected values.
No train.py is included because the selected model is deterministic and requires no training.
PPP factors are source data; recommended local prices and variable-cost ceiling remain explicit commercial hypotheses.
Stage 3 verdict is PASS_WITH_FIXES; proceed to Agent 4.
Treat brief.json as canonical strategy brief; stage-1 narrative MD/DOCX are historical snapshots and predictive wording in them is superseded.
Never use a time-axis mini-chart in the free preview; show current score and contextual reference only.
Keep 30-day outputs explicitly conditional what-if scenarios; if comprehension testing shows material confusion, remove the horizon and use snapshot-only.
Do not copy individual assessment responses, score, or PDF to the owner/operator by default.
No answer values, score, email, band, or report contents in third-party analytics.
Payment stays disabled in phase 1; local prices are hypotheses, not willingness-to-pay evidence.
FRIDAY RoBERTa LoRA is not production-approved until its Apache-2.0 vs MIT license conflict is resolved.
Agent 4 uses Vercel as primary deployment and Netlify as documented alternative.
Agent 4 ports the deterministic Python engine to TypeScript; Python remains QA oracle only.
Agent 4 validation mode sends an explicitly disclosed operational copy to OWNER_EMAIL as required by the factory workflow.
Agent 4 adds one_generic_action to final outputs_spec because the inherited free_preview referenced it without a matching output definition.
assumptions: The inaccessible Notion page titled MindGuard represents a B2C concept for burnout/stress prediction.
3.5B working people is used as a rough global workforce proxy for order-of-magnitude calculations.
15% professional/managerial share is an internal TAM assumption, not an external statistic.
25% of long-hours workers are assumed digitally reachable/B2C-fit for a rough SAM; segments overlap.
Keyword volume figures from 2023 remain directionally useful but must be refreshed before acquisition planning.
StressCast is a working name; domain and trademark availability have not been verified.
Proposed country prices are internal hypotheses, not observed market prices.
The two-item scenario movement is a sensitivity design choice and has no claimed empirical probability of occurring within 30 days.
PUMA benchmark values are contextual references from Danish human-service workers, not global clinical norms.
The CBI is treated as commercially usable because validation literature describes the instrument as public domain; retain attribution and source records.
The US$0.50 variable-cost figure is a budget ceiling assumption, not an observed vendor quote.
A 30-day default retention for individual validation payloads is a product starting point and requires legal confirmation per market.
The owner-copy validation workflow is acceptable only with explicit disclosure, restricted access and manual-fulfillment purpose.
The build package can be implemented without a Python runtime dependency.
